_note: Back-test cases: each applies a real intervention type to a representative Jurong East corridor, runs it through the LIVE HELIO engine, and compares the modelled response to a MEASURED corridor/site-level outcome from a real built project. IMPORTANT SCOPE: measured values are corridor/site field measurements; HELIO models a whole-district elasticity, so its numbers are expected to be smaller (under-claim by design). The test is directional (does HELIO move the right way?) + posture (is it conservative vs field results?). Sources in data/comparable_projects.json.
